#The asset's OEE/info tag: its kanoaMES OEE tags (which the module keeps for every OEE asset; the [Kanoa] Line UDT
	#isn't always there) in one document that changes whenever any of them does. Flattened to the names the Line UDT's
	#OEE folder had; dates are in milliseconds, as that binding gave them. None without an asset
	if value is None: return None
	def folder(name):
		try: return value[name]
		except: return None
	def field(values, name):
		try: return values[name]
		except: return None
	status, run = folder('Status'), folder('Current Run')
	info = {}
	for name in ['modeId', 'modeName', 'modeTypeName', 'modeColor', 'modeSourceName', 'userName', 'iconPath', 'workOrderId',
			'workOrderName', 'workOrderTitle', 'reqdQty', 'woActualQty', 'itemId', 'itemName', 'itemDescription', 'infeedUnits',
			'outfeedUnits', 'wasteUnits', 'packageCount', 'woRemainingMinutes', 'shiftId', 'shiftNameId', 'shiftName', 'shiftStart',
			'shiftEnd', 'scheduleBlockId', 'scheduleStart', 'scheduleEnd', 'stateName', 'stateStart', 'stateTypeName', 'stateColor',
			'stateTypeColor', 'stateIconPath', 'assetId']:
		info[name] = field(status, name)
	for name in ['startDate', 'durationSecs', 'runtimeSecs', 'unplannedDowntimeSecs', 'plannedDowntimeSecs', 'targetCount',
			'standardRate', 'period', 'infeedRateSecs', 'availability', 'performance', 'quality', 'infeedCount', 'outfeedCount',
			'wasteCount']:
		info[name] = field(run, name)
	#As the module works it out for the Line tags: the run's outfeed per minute, in production only
	duration, outfeed = info['durationSecs'], info['outfeedCount']
	info['outfeedRatePerMinute'] = outfeed / (duration / 60.0) if info['modeTypeName'] == 'Production' and duration and outfeed is not None else None
	info['endDate'] = None
	return info

viewParams = value['viewParams']
	filters = system.kanoa.dashboard.getWidgetFilters(self.page.props.pageId, viewParams, self.session.custom.kanoa, self.session.props.device.timezone.id)
	filters = dict(filters) if filters else {}

	#An explicit assetPath param wins over the dashboard asset selector; getWidgetFilters keeps the selector's assetId, so drop it
	if viewParams.has_key('assetPath') and viewParams['assetPath']: filters['assetId'] = None
	#Off a dashboard page getWidgetFilters returns {}; fall back to the params alone
	for k, v in viewParams.items():
		if not filters.has_key(k): filters[k] = v
	return filters

PERCENT = ['OEE', 'availability', 'performance', 'quality']
	LABELS = {'OEE': 'OEE', 'availability': 'Availability', 'performance': 'Performance', 'quality': 'Quality', 'outfeedCount': 'Outfeed Count', 'infeedCount': 'Infeed Count', 'wasteCount': 'Waste Count', 'packageCount': 'Package Count', 'targetCount': 'Target Count', 'outfeedRatePerMinute': 'Outfeed Rate / Min', 'infeedRateSecs': 'Infeed Rate (s)', 'standardRate': 'Standard Rate', 'runtimeSecs': 'Runtime', 'durationSecs': 'Duration', 'plannedDowntimeSecs': 'Planned Downtime', 'unplannedDowntimeSecs': 'Unplanned Downtime', 'woActualQty': 'WO Actual Qty', 'reqdQty': 'WO Required Qty', 'woRemainingMinutes': 'WO Remaining (min)', 'stateName': 'State', 'modeName': 'Mode', 'itemName': 'Item', 'workOrderName': 'Work Order', 'shiftName': 'Shift'}
	UNIT_MEMBERS = {'outfeedCount': 'outfeedUnits', 'infeedCount': 'infeedUnits', 'wasteCount': 'wasteUnits', 'woActualQty': 'outfeedUnits', 'reqdQty': 'outfeedUnits', 'targetCount': 'outfeedUnits'}

	#Over a date range, the range's figures; the rest (mode, state, item, work order...) is live
	RANGE = ['availability', 'performance', 'quality', 'outfeedCount', 'infeedCount', 'wasteCount', 'targetCount', 'runtimeSecs',
			 'durationSecs', 'plannedDowntimeSecs', 'unplannedDowntimeSecs', 'infeedRateSecs', 'standardRate', 'packageCount']
	def member(name):
		if rangeOEE is not None and name in RANGE:
			try: return rangeOEE[name]
			except: return None
		try: return oee[name]
		except: return None

	def toNumber(v):
		#Configurator text fields save numbers as strings; blank means not set
		if v is None or isinstance(v, bool): return None
		try: return float(str(v).strip())
		except: return None

	def fmtNumber(v, decimals):
		return ('{:,.%df}' % decimals).format(v)

	def fmtDuration(secs):
		secs = int(round(abs(secs)))
		h, m, s = secs // 3600, (secs % 3600) // 60, secs % 60
		if h: return '%dh %02dm' % (h, m)
		if m: return '%dm %02ds' % (m, s)
		return '%ds' % s

	filters, oee = value['filters'] or {}, value['oee']
	rangeOEE = value.get('rangeOEE')
	key = filters.get('oeeValue') or 'OEE'
	decimals = toNumber(filters.get('decimals'))
	decimals = 1 if decimals is None else max(0, min(int(decimals), 4))
	higherIsBetter = filters.get('higherIsBetter') is not False
	warningPct = toNumber(filters.get('warningPct'))
	warningPct = 10.0 if warningPct is None else abs(warningPct)
	target = toNumber(filters.get('target'))
	isPercent = key in PERCENT
	isDuration = key.endswith('Secs') and key != 'infeedRateSecs'

	kpi = {'label': filters.get('label') or LABELS.get(key, key), 'value': None, 'text': '--', 'unit': '', 'color': 'var(--kcOnSurface)', 'status': 'none', 'targetText': '', 'deltaText': '', 'tooltip': ''}
	kpi['assetName'] = (filters.get('assetPath') or '').split('\\')[-1]

	if oee is None and rangeOEE is None:
		kpi['tooltip'] = 'No OEE data for this asset'
		kpi['color'] = 'var(--kcOnSurfaceVariant)'
		return kpi

	if key == 'OEE':
		a, p, q = toNumber(member('availability')), toNumber(member('performance')), toNumber(member('quality'))
		raw = a * p * q if None not in (a, p, q) else None
	else:
		raw = member(key)

	number = toNumber(raw)
	if number is None:
		#Text members (state, mode, item...) display as-is and are never color-coded
		kpi['text'] = '--' if raw is None or str(raw) == '' else str(raw)
		return kpi

	if isPercent: number = number * 100.0
	kpi['value'] = number
	if isPercent: kpi['unit'] = '%'
	elif key in UNIT_MEMBERS: kpi['unit'] = member(UNIT_MEMBERS[key]) or ''
	elif key == 'woRemainingMinutes': kpi['unit'] = 'min'
	kpi['text'] = fmtDuration(number) if isDuration else fmtNumber(number, decimals)

	if target is None: return kpi

	fmt = lambda v: (fmtDuration(v) if isDuration else fmtNumber(v, decimals) + ('%' if isPercent else ''))
	kpi['targetText'] = 'Target ' + fmt(target)
	delta = number - target
	kpi['deltaText'] = ('+' if delta >= 0 else '-') + fmt(abs(delta))

	shortfall = -delta if higherIsBetter else delta
	if shortfall <= 0: kpi['status'], kpi['color'] = 'good', 'var(--kcGood)'
	elif shortfall <= abs(target) * warningPct / 100.0: kpi['status'], kpi['color'] = 'warning', 'var(--kcOK)'
	else: kpi['status'], kpi['color'] = 'bad', 'var(--kcBad)'
	kpi['tooltip'] = '%s %s target (%s)' % (kpi['label'], {'good': 'meets', 'warning': 'is near', 'bad': 'is below' if higherIsBetter else 'is above'}[kpi['status']], kpi['targetText'])
	return kpi
